title: hieracium sagittatum subsp. breadalbanense
intro: Hieracium sagittatum subsp. breadalbanense, commonly known as arrowhead hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that provide health benefits such as wound healing and skin protection. The therapeutic actions of arrowhead hawkweed include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which make it effective in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium sagittatum subsp. breadalbanense include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
